# Combining mark cell-run golden fixture
# Unicode 15.0.0 — UAX #29 grapheme clusters
#
# Combining marks are absorbed into the preceding grapheme cluster.
# The cluster width equals the base character's width; combining marks
# add 0 cells.  A lone combining mark at line start is a zero-width
# cluster of kind=combining.
#
# Format: description | utf8 bytes (hex) | tab_width → total_cells | spans
# Kind codes: T=text, C=combining, TAB=tab, CTL=control, INV=invalid_utf8

# 'a' (U+0061, 1 byte) + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT (U+0301, 2 bytes CC 81)
# Grapheme cluster: base='a' (width 1) extended by U+0301 (combining)
# → 1 span of byte_len=3, cell_width=1, kind=text
latin_a_acute     | 61 CC 81       | 4 → 1 | 0:3:1:T

# 'e' + COMBINING MACRON (U+0304, 2 bytes CC 84)
latin_e_macron    | 65 CC 84       | 4 → 1 | 0:3:1:T

# 'a' + two combining marks: COMBINING GRAVE (U+0300) + COMBINING TILDE (U+0303)
# U+0300 = CC 80, U+0303 = CC 83
# → 1 cluster of 5 bytes
latin_a_grave_tilde | 61 CC 80 CC 83 | 4 → 1 | 0:5:1:T

# Lone combining mark: COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT alone at line start
# No base character → kind=combining, width=0
lone_acute        | CC 81          | 4 → 0 | 0:2:0:C

# Two consecutive lone combining marks
# First U+0301 starts a combining cluster; second U+0300 extends it
# → 1 cluster of 4 bytes, width 0, kind=combining
two_lone_combining | CC 81 CC 80   | 4 → 0 | 0:4:0:C

# 'n' + COMBINING TILDE (U+0303): Spanish 'ñ'
latin_n_tilde     | 6E CC 83       | 4 → 1 | 0:3:1:T

# Wide base + combining mark:
# CJK U+4E2D (中, E4 B8 AD, 3 bytes) + COMBINING ACUTE ACCENT (CC 81)
# → 1 cluster of 5 bytes, width=2 (wide base), kind=text
wide_base_combining | E4 B8 AD CC 81 | 4 → 2 | 0:5:2:T
